name: list_drafts
title: List drafts
description: Lists the agent's draft document lists awaiting the preparer's review: each draft's ID, client, number of documents, number of flags to check, and review status.

name: open_review
title: Open a draft for review
description: Opens one draft on the preparer's review screen. Returns a readable summary of its documents, flags and notes. Only the preparer can approve, on the screen.

draft_id.description: The draft's ID, d plus two digits, such as d07; list_drafts gives them.
draft_id.title: Draft Id

name: save_review
title: Save review
description: Stores the preparer's decisions so far. Used by the review screen only.

draft_id.description: The draft's ID, d plus two digits, such as d07; list_drafts gives them.
draft_id.title: Draft Id

review_token.description: The review token open_review gave the review screen.
review_token.title: Review Token

draft_sha256.description: The draft's SHA-256, as open_review gave it to the review screen.
draft_sha256.title: Draft Sha256

decisions.description: The preparer's decisions: documents, custom_requests, added, follow_ups and flags_checked.
decisions.title: Decisions

host.description: The host's name and version from ui/initialize.
host.title: Host

name: approve_review
title: Approve list
description: Approves the preparer's document list for a draft. Final. Used by the review screen only.

draft_id.description: The draft's ID, d plus two digits, such as d07; list_drafts gives them.
draft_id.title: Draft Id

review_token.description: The review token open_review gave the review screen.
review_token.title: Review Token

draft_sha256.description: The draft's SHA-256, as open_review gave it to the review screen.
draft_sha256.title: Draft Sha256

decisions.description: The preparer's decisions: documents, custom_requests, added, follow_ups and flags_checked.
decisions.title: Decisions

host.description: The host's name and version from ui/initialize.
host.title: Host

name: approved_list
title: Approved list
description: Gives a draft's approved document list and follow-up questions as text, or says it is not approved yet. The list stays with the preparer.

draft_id.description: The draft's ID, d plus two digits, such as d07; list_drafts gives them.
draft_id.title: Draft Id
